Questions

What is the median annual wage for Data scientists in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Data Scientists in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $127,360.

What is the hourly median for Data scientists in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Data Scientists in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $61.23.

How many Data scientists work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 3,730 wage-and-salary Data Scientists in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Data scientists in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.71. Values above 1.00 mean Data Scientists are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Data scientists in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Data Scientists in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $126,830.

How does Austin's Data scientists median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($127,360) is $19,720 higher than Chicago ($107,640) and $37,380 lower than Seattle ($164,740). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
